CSTAT-P1_hartlap.citation: Hartlap, Simon & Schneider 2007, A&A 464, 399 -- REAL and correctly referenced, unlike the retracted precedent in CSTAT-O1
CSTAT-P1_hartlap.at_N50_p262: negative, i.e. the singularity restated: no inverse exists and no correction rescues one
CSTAT-P1_hartlap.the_part_this_campaign_did_not_have: if any downstream step truncates to a subspace with p_effective < N to make inversion possible, the precision matrix THERE is still biased by finite N=50, and the bias makes chi2 too SMALL -- a truncation chosen for tractability introduces an error in the flattering direction
CSTAT-P1_hartlap.requirement: any consumer that inverts a truncated C_stat MUST state p_effective, N, and whether a Hartlap-style correction was applied -- and if not, why not
CSTAT-P1_hartlap.WARNING_what_this_paper_IS_AND_IS_NOT: Its abstract's final sentence gives 'an analytic proof for the fact that the estimated covariance matrix is singular if P>N'. HARTLAP IS THE CANONICAL CITATION FOR WHY YOU CANNOT INVERT A COVARIANCE WITH MORE BINS THAN REALIZATIONS -- IT IS NOT A LICENCE TO SHIP ONE. At our numbers (50-262-2)/(50-1) = -4.37: a NEGATIVE debiasing factor, so the formula does not degrade gracefully, it becomes MEANINGLESS. If Hartlap is cited in a technote as support for publishing a rank-deficient C_stat, a referee finds it immediately and it damages the section it was meant to defend. Cite it ONLY for the bias correction in a truncated subspace where p_effective < N, which is all CSTAT-P1a uses.
CSTAT-P1_hartlap.caveat: the debiasing factor's algebraic form was read in secondary sources because the journal page returned 403; the singularity proof and the P<N condition are verbatim from the abstract

n_reported_rule_CSTAT_D0e.why_it_is_wrong: a cell can be REPORTED (comp > 0) and carry exactly zero replica variance if all 50 draws land on the same value, which is plausible in a low-occupancy catch bin. Its diagonal is 0.0 and the inferred count silently undercounts. On THIS object it is wrong by construction: the 266 mask deliberately contains four identically-zero cells, so sum(d > 0) reads 262 where n_reported is 266.
n_reported_rule_CSTAT_D0e.zero_diagonal_treatment: a zero on the reduced diagonal is a fact to REPORT by index, NOT a cell to drop -- dropping one would silently change the published dimension
n_reported_rule_CSTAT_D0e.related_but_OUT_OF_SCOPE: p4_validate_active_lateral_fps.py:70's PSD gate bool(ev[0] >= -1e-12*abs(ev[-1])) is a NEGATIVITY test that an exact zero satisfies, so a rank-49 matrix passes silently. min_over_max_eig is already recorded at :69, so a rank threshold is missing, not a measurement. Recorded so nobody reads psd=True there as evidence of full rank.
